markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (70%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (24%) stays in the 90% conformal set while invasive risk is 0% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 70%, InSitu 24%, Normal 6%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; InSitu stays plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 94th OOD percentile [F6] | Passable quality; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 1/5 Benign (20%); 3 Normal, 1 InSitu [F5] | Weak neighbor support for Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above typical (+1.08, contrib -0.42); 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below typical (+0.12, contrib +0.40); 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scarce (-0.55, contrib -0.39); 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Low (-0.47, contrib +0.35); 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Dead (3%) and epithelial (4%) cells** (regions 0, 6, 11) · context · 93rd, 7th percentiles [F7, F8]; sparse nuclei, wrong-direction validation · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- An atypical or in situ lesion exists; drafted orders suggest deeper levels and CK5/6, ER stains.
- Tissue is Normal (3/5 nearest neighbors, 88% match to BACH_0236) or misread at 94th OOD percentile.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 11**: Highest risk (2%–3%), 20 neoplastic nuclei, duct-confined atypia; exclude in situ lesion.
2. **Regions 0, 8**: Top regions for Unreliable normal lobules and Validated invasion; verify two-layered epithelium.
3. **Region 7**: Top region for TILs and Unreliable mitoses; check mitoses and stromal lymphocytes.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names Benign, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
